articles.title: KPDCL Announces Power Shutdowns in Srinagar, Kulgam - Kashmir Life
articles.full_text:
SRINAGAR: Power supply to several areas of Srinagar and Kulgam districts will remain affected on November 9, 11 and 14 due to scheduled shutdowns of two 33 kV transmission lines, the Kashmir Power Distribution Corporation Limited (KPDCL) said on Thursday.
According to the Chief Engineer, Distribution, KPDCL, the shutdown of the 33 kV Wanganpora-Soura line will affect electricity supply to Nowshera, parts of 90 Feet Road and adjoining areas from 9 am to 3 pm on November 11 and 14.
Similarly, the shutdown of the 33 kV Kulgam-Devsar line will disrupt power supply to Devsar, Sopat, Akhal, Hablish and adjoining areas from 10 am to 3 pm on November 9 and 11.
The shutdowns have been scheduled to facilitate necessary work on the respective transmission lines.
